name: Raxio Kinshasa DRC1
notes: Raxio's provider page places DRC1 in Limete industriel, Kinshasa; DCD reported inauguration on 2024-08-23, 1.5MW IT power, 1,542 sqm and up to 400 racks.

name: OADC Texaf Digital Kinshasa
notes: OADC official page lists the Kinshasa facility with 2MW site load and 1,000 sqm technical space; DCD reported the first phase live at Silikin Village, Kinshasa, with 1,500 sqm and 550 racks.

name: Orange Business RDC Data Center
notes: Orange Business RDC offers enterprise datacenter hosting with rack space, protected AC/DC power and links to the Orange RDC data center; Orange RDC's official LinkedIn described a March 2026 client visit to its Orange Business Data Center. Public source does not disclose capacity or exact address.

name: GBS Datacenter
notes: DataCenterMap lists a Kinshasa city-center GBS datacenter offering suites, cabinets, remote hands, bare-metal/cloud servers and rack/satellite landing-station hosting; operator site was not reachable during check, so confidence is aggregate-only.

name: UNITED Kinshasa
notes: DataCenterMap lists UNITED Kinshasa at CrownTower, 165 Av Batetela, with cabinets, servers and remote-hands service; United's own hosting page confirms active hosting services but does not independently detail the data-center facility or capacity.

name: Goma neutral Tier-3/Tier-4 data center plan
developer: Government of the DRC / Agence pour le Developpement du Numerique
notes: The Plan National du Numerique Horizon 2025 project 10 calls for at least five neutral Tier-3/Tier-4 data centers in urban centers including Goma. No confirmed construction or operational Goma facility was found in this pass.
